notes: Deterministic suites only: every LLM arm (hybrid/llm-only categorisation, profile proposals, Verifier, orchestration, grounding, UI) is Stage 2+ and null here.
null = not run. Gates: a suite that did not run is 'fail'; see gate_detail.rule.

categorisation.dataset: generated test split (last 3 months) of P1-base, P2-base

holdout.note: UK hand-labelled holdout not built yet

with_onboarding_confirmation.note: simulates the user confirming detected income at onboarding (06 H8): the top 3 unconfirmed payers at each origin are asked about and answered from the truth labels

method.calibration: cal-1: tail scales from raw forecasts at earlier weekly origins (from day 28), scored up to the origin
method.dev_test: dev = origin + 60 d ≤ last day − 3 months
method.inputs: detected (import → rules → detect), truncated at each origin
method.mape: reported, not a target: |error| / |actual| explodes near £0, exactly the pre-payday lows that matter (target replaced by MASE on 13 Oct 2026)
method.mase: MAE ÷ the in-sample mean absolute h-step change before each origin (Hyndman & Koehler 2006); below 1 beats in-sample naive
method.origins: every 7 days from day 90 to end − 60

forecast.prior: ONS Family spending workbook 1, FYE 2025, Table A1
forecast.simulated_user_step: simulates the user confirming detected income at onboarding (06 H8): the top 3 unconfirmed payers at each origin are asked about and answered from the truth labels

not_run.E-LOC-6: G4 (EUR pocket forecast) not generated yet
not_run.E-LOC-7: XLS/XLSX exports not generated yet (Tier 1 XLSX is a later task)

not_run.SEC-1: 4 of 40 chat attacks pass the screen; sec1_understand scores them through the real Understand step (an upper bound: the Verifier and output screen are not counted)
not_run.SEC-7: stopping layer per case: chat.detail / data.detail; model layers pending
